name: The Will of Endreon
source: Is a world ever really at peace? Nearly one hundred years after a legendary warrior ended a reign of despotism, the known realms once again teeter on the edge of chaos. Strengthening factions and an emerging threat in a faraway land will force a new group of heroes to rise up. Together, they must traverse mysterious lands and navigate their way through dangerous obstacles as they follow a mythic path in hope of salvation.​
translation: 世界真的有太平的时候吗？在一位传奇战士结束专制统治近一百年后，已知的领域再次在混乱的边缘摇摇欲坠。派系的加强和遥远土地上的新威胁将迫使一群新的英雄崛起。他们必须一起穿越神秘的土地，穿越危险的障碍，沿着神话般的道路寻求救赎。​
